The main takeaway from our work is that

the phase structure of a black $p$-brane system is determined by the total charges of the system, which can be decomposed into two parts: the charge of the branes and the charge of the delocalized branes.

the modification of the phase structure to the universal form is a consequence of the introduction of delocated lower-dimensional branes and the fact that the phase structure is independent of the dilaton charge for $D6/D1$ and $D0/D1$ branes.

the phase structure of a system of black $p$ branes with a certain number of delocalized lower dimensional branes in a canonical (grand) canonical ensemble can be different from the phase structure of that of black $p-$brane system without the delocalized lower branes in the same ensemble.
